SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.*, t.risk_quantity hiddenDangerNum, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.safety_role_code) as depart_role_code FROM ytsafety_location_info t ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) tmp
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyNames}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyNames}, '%')) ) staff_mapping ON staff_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND staff_mapping.role_code = tmp.safety_role_code

SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.*, t.risk_quantity hiddenDangerNum, CONCAT(t.org_code, '_', t.safety_role_code) as depart_role_code FROM ytsafety_location_info t ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) tmp
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT depart_code, role_code FROM ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping WHERE depart_code IS NOT NULL AND role_code IS NOT NULL AND (emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyNames}, '%') OR emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.safetyNames}, '%')) ) staff_mapping ON staff_mapping.depart_code = tmp.org_code AND staff_mapping.role_code = tmp.safety_role_code
AND tmp.id IN
#{item}
SELECT tmp.* FROM ( SELECT t.*, t.risk_quantity hiddenDangerNum FROM ytsafety_location_info t WHERE t.id = #{id} ) tmp WHERE tmp.del_flag = 0

SELECT t.names FROM ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.emp_name SEPARATOR ',') AS names, FIND_IN_SET(m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path) AS depth FROM safety_group_info gi INNER JOIN ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m ON FIND_IN_SET(m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path) > 0 AND m.role_code = #{roleCode} WHERE gi.status = 'Y' AND gi.code = #{orgCode} GROUP BY m.depart_code, gi.org_code_path ) t ORDER BY t.depth DESC LIMIT 1
